name: Flow Residences
label: Well above market value
paymentPlan: down payment 20%; 30% during construction; 10% on handover; 40% post-handover
overview: On the A-Island of the Dubai Islands, Flow Residences by Main Realty is a boutique coastal development that provides a luxurious lifestyle characterized by elegance, tranquility, and contemporary refinement. This limited-edition neighborhood, which consists of just 50 distinctive villas spread across six stories, combines Dubai's upscale sensibilities with Miami-inspired design. With features like private plunge pools in certain duplexes and smart home technologies, Flow Residences reinvents waterfront living with elegance, closeness, and a smooth indoor-outdoor lifestyle.
